items.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is ‘unpatchable’
items.summary: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.

items.title: Elon Musk says ousting Jensen Huang is like ‘kicking Michael Jordan off your team’
items.summary: “I don’t think [Huang is] disloyal to the United States," Musk said.

items.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella remains confident in Nvidia after Huang’s exit
items.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella expressed confidence in Jensen Huang's successor Colette Kress, who is serving as Nvidia's interim CEO.

items.title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
items.summary: Microsoft's CEO says AI agents could disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink how they compete for customers.

items.title: Anthropic reportedly prices IPO at $83 a share, above projected range
items.summary: The long-awaited IPO reportedly values the company at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis.

items.title: Nvidia created a weird bit of intrigue by not filing a routine SEC report
items.summary: One Wall Street analyst got to the bottom of Nvidia's surprise announcement that it wouldn't be filing its formal quarterly results document, the 10-Q, for weeks.

items.title: Palmer Luckey warns AI-powered cyberattacks are outpacing defenses: ‘It’s time to start running’
items.summary: The Anduril co-founder says outdated technology is leaving systems vulnerable to a new wave of AI-enabled attacks.

items.title: Palmer Luckey thinks China is ‘thrilled to have Jensen out,’ so he wants the ousted Nvidia CEO reinstated
items.summary: "It makes America weaker to knock him out," the Anduril CEO said about ousted Nvidia leader Jensen Huang.

items.title: Sam Altman says his life is so weird that he’s unfazed by Andrew Garfield portraying him in upcoming movie
items.summary: "It doesn't feel like it's in like the top 10 weirdest things about my life," Altman said.

items.title: Snapchat now lets developers build AR Lenses with AI assistants like Claude Code and Cursor
items.summary: Lens creators can describe the Lens they want in plain language, and their AI assistant handles the process from start to finish, Snapchat says.

items.title: Google’s AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
items.summary: Google's new temporary threads let users have conversations in AI Mode without adding them to their search history or influencing future recommendations.

items.title: More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked
items.summary: Citi is the latest major financial institution to put the breaks on personal finance AI agents.

items.title: Sam Altman warns against a future where AI, not humans, calls the shots
items.summary: Sam Altman and Greg Brockman pushed back against Silicon Valley's growing debate over an AI takeover, while acknowledging the challenges of keeping advanced models under human control.

items.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
items.summary: Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down last week amid several scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

items.title: Nvidia clarifies when it will — and won’t — keep financing neoclouds
items.summary: If Nvidia is backstopping a data center loan, it won't be on the hook unless the neocould has independent financing and gets the facility built, with Nvidia gear installed, interim CEO Colette Kress explained.

items.title: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI to make enterprise documents usable by AI agents
items.summary: With a team of just seven, Unsiloed AI plans to compete with tech giants and specialized startups in the crowded AI document-processing market.

items.title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed US robotics companies the data they need
items.summary: Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups such as Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.

items.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
items.summary: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.

items.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
items.summary: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.

items.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
items.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO says the company is done selling chips to China. How much will that cost?
